prophets.name: Prophet Nuh (Noah) - Peace be upon him
prophets.story_summary: Prophet Nuh built a big, beautiful boat and saved his family and animals from a big flood. He was very patient.
prophets.quran_reference: Quran 29:14 (950-year mission, real citation, verified) — general narrative also in Surah Nuh 71:1-28 and Surah Hud 11
prophets.confidence: verified — 2026-08-05, real citation replacing prior Unknown source reference

prophets.name: Prophet Ibrahim (Abraham) - Peace be upon him
prophets.story_summary: Prophet Ibrahim loved Allah so much. He built the beautiful Ka'bah with his son Ismail.
prophets.quran_reference: Quran 21:69 (the fire made cool and safe for Ibrahim) — real, verified citation
prophets.confidence: verified — 2026-08-05, real citation replacing prior Unknown source reference

prophets.name: Prophet Muhammad - Peace be upon him
prophets.story_summary: The last and best Prophet, who taught everyone kindness, honesty, and love for Allah.
prophets.key_lesson: Kindness, honesty, and following the best example
prophets.confidence: verified — primary source directly fetched, full rigor

prophets.name: Prophet Yunus (Jonah) - Peace be upon him
prophets.story_summary: Prophet Yunus was swallowed by a big whale in the deep, dark sea. Inside the whale, he trusted Allah and kept saying a special dua. Allah heard him, and the whale carried him safely to the shore.
prophets.key_lesson: Trust in Allah when things feel hard or scary, and always turn to Him
prophets.primary_source: Stories Of The Prophets By Ibn Kathir.pdf, chapter 'Prophet Yunus (Jonah)'
